Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId, absent, and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId, absent status, and specific date returns 200 OK and correct attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId, absent, and date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent status, and date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record for employeeId 123, absent true, date 2024-06-01

Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId and absent, but no date provided
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent status but no date uses current date and returns 200 OK
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId and absent, without date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent status, and current date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record for employeeId 456, absent false, date equal to current system date

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId but containing absent
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify that marking attendance without absent field returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId but missing absent
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with null request body
Description: Verify that marking attendance with null request body returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null or empty body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid list of attendance records
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with valid list of AttendanceDTOs returns 200 OK with correct counts and saved records
Pre-Conditions: Employees with given employeeIds exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of valid attendance records
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid records
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct
Verify savedRecords array contains attendance records matching input
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, and savedRecords matching input

Title: Mark batch attendance with some records missing employeeId or absent
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance skips invalid records and returns 200 OK with invalidEntries list and counts reflecting only valid records
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing some invalid attendance records (missing employeeId or absent)
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid records
Verify invalidEntries list contains employeeIds of invalid records where employeeId is present
Verify presentCount and absentCount counts are correct for valid records
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, invalidEntries list containing [202], presentCount and absentCount reflecting valid records

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that sending empty list to batch attendance endpoint returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty JSON array
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify that sending null as payload to batch attendance endpoint returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with records missing date field
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking uses current date for records missing date field and returns 200 OK with correct counts
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of attendance records where some have null date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedRecords contain attendance records with date set to current date for those missing date
Verify counts are correct
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedRecords containing attendance for employeeId 301 with current date and employeeId 302 with date 2024-06-01, counts correct

Title: Mark single attendance updates existing record and employee counters
Description: Verify that marking attendance for an employee on a date where attendance exists updates the record and adjusts employee present/absent counters accordingly
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists and has attendance record for given date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId, date, and absent status different from existing record
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record is updated with new absent status
Verify employee totalPresent and totalAbsent counters are updated correctly
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated attendance record and employee counters reflecting change from absent to present

Title: Mark batch attendance with all invalid records (missing employeeId or absent)
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking with all invalid records returns 200 OK with savedCount 0 and invalidEntries list containing all employeeIds present
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of attendance records all missing employeeId or absent
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount is 0
Verify invalidEntries list contains employeeIds of invalid records where employeeId is present
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 0 and invalidEntries list containing [501]

Title: Get all employees - success
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body is a JSON array
Verify each element in the array contains employee fields
Expected Result: Response status 200 with JSON array of employees

Title: Get employee by valid ID - success
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns the employee details when a valid ID is provided
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the database
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body contains employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 with employee details for ID 1

Title: Get employee by non-existing ID - returns empty employee
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns an empty employee object when the ID does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee with ID 9999 exists in the database
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body contains an empty employee object (default values)
Expected Result: Response status 200 with empty employee object

Title: Create new employee - success
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee creates a new employee successfully
Pre-Conditions: No employee with the same name and role exists
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 200 or 201
Verify the employee is saved in the database
Expected Result: Employee is created and saved successfully

Title: Create new employee - missing required fields
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee with missing fields still processes (no validation in code)
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with empty or partial employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 200 or 201
Verify the employee is saved with missing or default values
Expected Result: Employee is created with null or default values (no validation error)

Title: Update existing employee - success
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates an existing employee's details
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with updated employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body contains updated employee details
Verify the employee data is updated in the database
Expected Result: Employee with ID 1 is updated successfully and returned in response

Title: Update non-existing employee - returns 404
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} returns 404 when employee does not exist
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 404
Verify the response body is empty
Expected Result: Response status 404 with empty body

Title: Update employee - partial fields
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates only provided fields and keeps others unchanged
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 1 exists with known data
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with partial employee JSON body (e.g., only name)
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body contains updated name and unchanged other fields
Expected Result: Employee name updated, other fields remain unchanged

Title: Delete existing employee - success
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} deletes the employee successfully
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status code is 200 or 204
Verify the employee is removed from the database
Expected Result: Employee with ID 1 is deleted successfully

Title: Delete non-existing employee - no error
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} on non-existing employee does not cause error
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 or 204
Verify no error is returned
Expected Result: No error, response status 200 or 204

Title: Get all employees - empty database
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns empty list when no employees exist
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body is an empty JSON array
Expected Result: Response status 200 with empty array

Title: Create employee with maximum length fields
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee accepts employee with maximum length name and role
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body containing MAX_NAME and MAX_ROLE
Verify the response status code is 200 or 201
Verify the employee is saved with full name and role
Expected Result: Employee created successfully with maximum length fields

Title: Update employee with null body fields
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} with null fields updates employee fields to null
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with body fields set to null
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the employee fields are updated to null
Expected Result: Employee fields updated to null successfully
